summary.text: Michele Reynolds is a Republican state senator from Ohio who has represented District 3 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner and nonprofit CEO, she was previously a Madison Township trustee.

paragraphs.text: Michele Reynolds was born in Kankakee, Illinois.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Cincinnati in 1998 and a graduate degree from the Thomas Jefferson School of Law in 2016.
Her career experience includes working as a business owner and nonprofit CEO, and she was elected Madison Township trustee in 2019.
Reynolds took office in the Ohio Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Tina Maharath.
In 2023–2024 she was vice chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and also served on the Primary and Secondary Education, Rules and Reference, and Workforce and Higher Education committees.
Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as including the Jo Ann Davidson Ohio Leadership Institute, Columbus Realtors, the Ohio Black Republican Association and the Columbus chapter of the NAACP.
She advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Stacie Baker in the general election.
